notes.title: Major update, adding more powerful artifacts and other content!
notes.content: [p]Enhance the attributes of all holy objects and add many stronger holy objects;[/p][p]Endless caves, butterfly plains, missile ruins, forest cemeteries, dilapidated libraries, and Abyssal Caverns receive sacred objects every 50 levels they pass through, with higher levels yielding stronger sacred objects; [/p][p]The Double Demon King Hall and the Three Demon King Hall receive sacred rewards;[/p][p] Fix some game bugs;[/p][p] The Secret Treasure Chest has a chance to obtain advanced items.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985700/3bc45be4c923259946b80c941b58dcd64c8069e1.jpg"][/img][/p]
